about: Face types, the identity rig and the anchors they were set from (living/tools/characters/face_types.py; docs/CHARACTERS.md). Lengths are in units of the head's height H, chin to crown, unless a name says otherwise.

file.about: a character file's own size: every head is this high in the file, the chin at this height; the recipe's height and head multiplier size the person

rig.about: Identity bones. A person's value v in -1..1 gives the bone's change from its rest: least at -1, none at 0, most at 1 (a scale's rest is 1, a move's and a turn's 0). `move` is in thousandths of the head's height.

axes.x: across: file X; for a paired bone, away from the midline on both sides
axes.o: out of the cheek: 0.55 x + 0.83 y
axes.turns: for a paired bone the same sense on both sides: about y, the outer end up; about z, outward; about x (the jaw), the chin down
axes.note: every identity bone's rest rotation is none, so these are the head's axes

bones.name: J_Id_Cranium
bones.at: the head's middle at the brow line

values.note: pass 2's `forehead`: low and sloping to high and full

bones.name: J_Id_Corner_L
bones.at: the cheek corner beside the eye

values.note: new: how broad the front planes are
pass 2's `cheeks`: hollow to full, out of the cheek (0.55 away from the midline and 0.83 forward)

bones.name: J_Id_Jaw
bones.at: the jaw's hinge, under the ear

values.note: new: a flatter or steeper jaw line (the chin up or down about the jaw's hinge)
pass 2's `chin_length`: short (the chin's point up) to long (down)

bones.name: J_Id_Orbit_L
bones.at: the eye's middle, on the skin

values.note: new: the eye set deeper or shallower
pass 2's `eye_tilt`: outer corners down to up

bones.name: J_Adj_L_FaceEye
bones.at: behind the eye (the bone the look turns; it exists today)

values.note: pass 2's `nose_bridge`: how far the nose stands out
pass 2's `nose_tip`: turned down to turned up
pass 2's `mouth_height`: close under the nose (up) to low (down)
